issue.title: Reuse vault_rewrite for bob ref rename without changing reference transaction behavior
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-bj.4 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1. Verified at bob-cli d8a8f1f8: src/native/highlights_ref/rename/plan.rs execute path independently acquires maintenance and scan locks (190-245), pre-syncs (254), commits and recovers Git failures (347-413), and post-syncs (423); src/native/vault_rewrite/mod.rs now supplies a shared transaction used by theme and relation rename. Plan a behavior-preserving migration, first checking that the shared abstraction can retain PDF moves, scan locking, before-image restoration, reference identity checks, and existing JSON/exit codes. Add transaction coverage for those reference-specific invariants. This is a refactor proposal, not a known current reference defect. Searched all task statuses and the past week, and inspected active epics: no duplicate or active epic owns the migration. Related bob-cli-az changes PDF coordination in the same rename path; coordinate design with it.

task_type_fields.proposal: Move reference rename onto the shared vault_rewrite transaction while preserving reference-specific locks, PDF moves, rollback, identity, output, and sync behavior.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-bj rewrite-txn phase explicitly excluded reference rename and asked for this follow-up; relation and theme rename are already migrated.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-bj.4 note 1. The relation epic extracted a shared transaction, but reference rename still duplicates lock, sync, commit, and rollback code.

payload.description: Both can change the reference rename transaction; preserve PDF coordination and rollback semantics
The doctor proposal uses reference rename to repair identities; preserve the rename interface and behavior
